checks.title: work_orders.installer_user_id definition and nullability
checks.finding: Column is defined as nullable text with conditional partial index when installer_user_id IS NOT NULL.
checks.evidence: ALTER TABLE public.work_orders ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS installer_user_id text; CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_work_orders_installer_user_id ON public.work_orders(installer_user_id) WHERE installer_user_id IS NOT NULL;

checks.title: Foreign key constraint from work_orders.installer_user_id to public.users(id)
checks.finding: FK constraint work_orders_installer_user_id_fkey links installer_user_id to users(id) with ON DELETE SET NULL to preserve work order history if an installer is removed.
checks.evidence: ALTER TABLE public.work_orders ADD CONSTRAINT work_orders_installer_user_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (installer_user_id) REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;

checks.title: Data types across all modified and referenced columns
checks.finding: All column data types match canonical TypeScript and PostgreSQL schema: check_out_at (timestamptz), work_duration_minutes (integer), work_duration_formatted (text), and installer_user_id (text matching users.id text).
checks.evidence: Types: timestamptz, integer, text, and text FK referencing users(id text).

checks.title: technical_reports insert/upsert schema parity
checks.finding: technical_reports table exists in base schema (Migration 001/010) with matching column names, constraints, and JSON payload support. Upsert handles report edits cleanly.
checks.evidence: All 30 columns in INSERT INTO public.technical_reports match public.technical_reports schema definition.

checks.title: audit_logs.event_at verification and preflight check
checks.finding: Preflight explicitly verifies event_at exists on audit_logs. Migration 001 defines event_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(). Audit log insertion uses event_at.
checks.evidence: Preflight check guarantees event_at existence; gracefully notices if created_at is also present.

checks.title: fn_submit_technical_report_atomic implementation and row locking
checks.finding: Function is SECURITY DEFINER with fixed search_path (public, pg_temp), acquires pessimistic row lock FOR UPDATE on work_orders, and executes technical report upsert, WO status update, work duration computation, and audit logging in a single atomic database execution.
checks.evidence: FOR UPDATE row lock prevents concurrent modification races; SECURITY DEFINER with sanitized search_path prevents privilege escalation.

checks.title: EXECUTE privileges revoked from PUBLIC/anon and granted only to service_role
checks.finding: Function EXECUTE privilege is strictly revoked from PUBLIC, anon, and authenticated roles, and granted solely to service_role. Direct frontend client invocation without backend verification is strictly blocked (fail-closed).
checks.evidence: REVOKE ALL FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated; GRANT EXECUTE TO service_role;

checks.title: Report idempotency resolution and duplicate audit log suppression
checks.finding: If the report was already submitted (matched by report ID, payload, or existing record on the work order), the RPC updates the existing report without generating a duplicate audit log entry, returning is_idempotent: true.
checks.evidence: v_is_idempotent flag gates audit_logs insert and is returned in the JSON response.

checks.title: Transactional atomicity with preflight validation and rollback guarantees
checks.finding: The entire migration script is wrapped in BEGIN; ... COMMIT;. If preflight assertions (presence of required tables and columns) or post-migration checks fail, the entire transaction rolls back cleanly with zero partial changes.
checks.evidence: Enclosed in BEGIN/COMMIT block with preflight and postflight assertion blocks.

checks.title: Compatibility with MoraJaws custom application login architecture
checks.finding: MoraJaws uses custom application authentication where the security principal is public.users.id. Migration 014 links installer_user_id directly to public.users(id) and scopes report submissions via p_submitted_by_id, making it 100% compatible with custom application login without any dependency on Supabase GoTrue auth.users.
checks.evidence: installer_user_id references public.users(id); RPC authorizes based on authenticated internal account ID.
